questions.question: What abuse did Nehemiah find Tobiah had been given in the temple?
options: An altar set up in the high place just outside the town
A garden plot laid out beside the wall of the city
A large chamber in the courts of the house of God
A throne placed in the great hall of the governor
questions.answer: A large chamber in the courts of the house of God

questions.question: What did Nehemiah do about Sabbath-breaking in Jerusalem?
options: Allowed the trade to go on as before
Shut the gates before the Sabbath to stop trade
Placed a heavy tax on Sabbath sales
Ignored it and said nothing to the merchants
questions.answer: Shut the gates before the Sabbath to stop trade
